Score a simulation against observed flow

Source: R/scorecard.R
pdm_scorecard.Rd

Computes every score used by the calibration log. Unlike pdm_objectives(), which returns losses to minimise, these are diagnostics in their natural form, signed where the sign tells the calibrator which way to move.

Usage

pdm_scorecard(simulated, observed, log_offset = 0.01)

Arguments

simulated, observed

Numeric aligned nonnegative discharge vectors, m3/s. Missing observations are excluded; simulations at scored rows must be finite.

log_offset

Positive offset added before logarithms, m3/s.

Value

Named numeric vector, in the order of the table above.

Details

ScoreMeaningBest
nseNash-Sutcliffe efficiency1
log_nseNSE of log(flow + log_offset), weighting low flows1
kgeKling-Gupta efficiency (Gupta et al. 2009)1
kge_rCorrelation1
kge_alphaRatio of standard deviations, simulated over observed1
kge_betaRatio of means, simulated over observed1
rmseRoot mean square error, m3/s0
log_rmseRMSE of log(flow + log_offset)0
volume_errorSigned volume error as a fraction: positive is too wet0
abs_volume_errorAbsolute volume error as a fraction0
peak_errorSigned error in the highest flow as a fraction0
fdc_highVolume bias of the flow-duration curve above 2 per cent exceedance0
fdc_midBias in the slope of the curve between 20 and 70 per cent exceedance0
fdc_lowBias in the low-flow segment above 70 per cent exceedance0

The three flow-duration-curve signatures follow Yilmaz et al. (2008), as fractions rather than percentages; logarithms use log_offset so zero flows are allowed. A score that is undefined for the data, such as KGE for a constant simulation, is NA.

References

Gupta et al. (2009), doi:10.1016/j.jhydrol.2009.08.003; Yilmaz et al. (2008), doi:10.1029/2007WR006716.

Examples

obs <- c(1, 3, 8, 5, 3, 2, 1.5, 1.2, 1, 0.9)
pdm_scorecard(obs * 1.1, obs)
#>              nse          log_nse              kge            kge_r 
#>     0.9748630840     0.9819843080     0.8585786438     1.0000000000 
#>        kge_alpha         kge_beta             rmse         log_rmse 
#>     1.1000000000     1.1000000000     0.3427827300     0.0947600996 
#>     volume_error abs_volume_error       peak_error         fdc_high 
#>     0.1000000000     0.1000000000     0.1000000000               NA 
#>          fdc_mid          fdc_low 
#>     0.0004822624    -0.0009495880
